review:
Sweet Kingdom is a 7x7 cluster slot themed around a regal candy land. Cakes, doughnuts and chocolates pay in clusters of five or more, and wins tumble so new symbols drop in.

Treasure chest cash symbols can land and stick through each tumble. They only pay out if a key-shaped Collector symbol lands at the same time, after which they disappear. Three scatters award 10 free spins, during which cash symbols get a lifespan of one to five spins or last until a collector arrives, giving them more chances to be collected. Three more scatters add 10 spins. The advertised maximum is 10,000x. The 96.53% RTP is among the higher figures in Pragmatic's range.
